i.norm: Verifies that peek() returns false when the requested comparison length is less than the number of bytes currently held in the buffer. The buffer is loaded with 4 bytes (two add() calls of 2 bytes each). peek() is then called asking to compare only 2 bytes, which is less than the 4 bytes in the buffer, so it must return false. The default buffer capacity is 8192, so remaining space is 8192 - 4 = 8188.
Fill the buffer with 4 zero bytes via two separate add() calls
peek() with length (2) < currentNumberOfBytes (4) returns false
